description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an interface for a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with thread and process synchronization mechanisms, including methods for reading, writing, reserving space, and managing buffer state. It also includes nested classes and control structures for buffer management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class providing a shared, process-wide cyclic buffer with thread-safe and process-safe access, supporting read, write, reserve, and lock mechanisms.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested helper class for managing read positions within the cyclic buffer, supporting peek and tail calculations.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: ~CyclicBuffer()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the buffer tail pointer to reflect the latest write position.

methods.name: Overwritten
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been overwritten.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code from the buffer.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the buffer storage.

methods.name: IsLocked
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is currently locked.

methods.name: LockPid
methods.description: Returns the process ID that holds the lock.

methods.name: IsOverwrite
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is set to overwrite mode.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is properly initialized.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Returns the underlying file storage object.

methods.name: Used
methods.description: Returns the amount of used space in the buffer.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns the amount of free space in the buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the buffer.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the buffer integrity.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Relinquishes any blocking lock requests.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Acquires a lock on the buffer, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Reads data non-destructively from the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and consumes data from the buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when data becomes available.

methods.name: GetOverwriteSize
methods.description: Determines how much data can be overwritten.

methods.name: GetReadSize
methods.description: Determines how much data can be read.

methods.name: AssureFreeSpace
methods.description: Ensures enough free space is available in the buffer.

methods.name: AdminLock
methods.description: Locks the buffer administration for thread safety.

methods.name: AdminUnlock
methods.description: Unlocks the buffer administration.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Reevaluates buffer state.

methods.name: SignalLock
methods.description: Signals lock acquisition with optional wait time.
